data.title: 苍崎青子 · 沿海断崖的风衣长风孤傲
data.description: 三咲町郊外俯瞰大海的陡峭断崖上，晚风猎猎。青子身穿敞开的经典卡其色长风衣，内穿贴身黑色高领衫与紧身牛仔裤。海浪拍打悬崖掀起千堆雪，落日晚霞染红了半边苍穹。她单手按住被风狂乱吹卷的赤红长发，眼眸如鹰隼般锐利从容，向你展露出作为旅途行者的绝世英姿与无拘无束的自由灵魂。
data.location: coastal cliff overlooking churning ocean waves under sunset sky
data.action: standing on rocky cliff edge, long trench coat billowing in sea storm wind, holding auburn hair against wind, intense confident gaze at viewer
data.lighting: dramatic golden and crimson sunset rays cutting through sea mist
data.mood: epic sovereign freedom, breathtaking wind-swept power
data.promptProse: Standing atop a rugged coastal cliff against a blazing sunset, Aoko Aozaki wears a flowing trench coat caught in the ocean gale. Wind whips her long red hair as she looks forward with untamed, confident brilliance.
data.animaCaption: Standing on a coastal cliff edge at sunset, her trench coat and long hair whip in the wind.
